A rather deranged alchemist by the name of Quinius lives not far from here. He knows the recipe for the elixir, but he hasn't spoken a word with me since that incident in the tavern with the liquor and the burnt hair. How was I to know that it would explode?

Well anyway, perhaps you could get some Soul-Ex from Quinius?

Recentemente venho investigando uma manifestação misteriosa e sobrenatural num túmulo antigo não muito longe daqui. Confirmei a presença de níveis altos de essência espiritual no sítio do túmulo. Se os fantasmas de fato se manifestarem, poderão representar uma ameaça para a região inteira. Eu poderia impedir a manifestação, mas precisarei de um Elixir das Almas para destruir a essência espiritual no túmulo. Nós, caçadoras de fantasmas, gostamos de chamar o elixir de Soul-Ex.

I have recently been investigating a mysterious and supernatural manifestation at an ancient grave not far from here. I have confirmed the presence of high levels of spiritual essence at the grave site. If the ghosts actually manifest themselves, they could pose a threat to the entire region. I could hinder the manifestation, but I will need an Elixir of Souls to destroy the spiritual essence at the grave. We ghosthunters like to call the elixir: Soul-Ex.

A rather deranged alchemist by the name of Quinius lives not far from here. He knows the recipe for the elixir, but he hasn't spoken a word with me since that incident in the tavern with the liquor and the burnt hair. How was I to know that it would explode?

Well anyway, perhaps you could get some Soul-Ex from Quinius?
